name: – Paulo do Nascimento Cabral – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT on the role of social, economic and environmental standards in safeguarding fair competition for all aquatic food products and improving food security
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how European fishing and fish farming should be protected and supported. It asks for stronger rules so that imported fish meet the same social, environmental and safety standards as EU fish, and for better labelling so shoppers know where their fish comes from. It also wants more money and less paperwork for the sector, support for small-scale fishers and island regions, and a new action plan for fish food by the end of 2026.

- The Parliament asks the European Commission to propose new labelling rules, a fish action plan and more funding; nothing changes yet.
- It affects fishers, fish farmers, fish processors, importers and shoppers across the EU.
- Next, the Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests.
